test_cases.description: Legacy response returned for non-selected user
Pi shadow response not visible in user-facing UI
Terminal event fires exactly once per request
Pi shadow does not trigger provider serving calls visible in browser network tab
Session isolation: Pi state does not persist to next session
Multi-turn conversation: legacy path maintained for non-selected users
Error handling: Pi shadow failure falls back transparently to legacy
Bucket assignment consistent across page refresh (same session)
No Pi-specific UI elements leaked to non-Pi users
Browser console: zero Pi-related error or warning messages
Network requests: shadow calls not observable in browser DevTools
Performance: page response time unchanged for non-selected users
Post-restart: Pi shadow not exposed in resumed sessions (S2 post_restart window)
Concurrency: no session cross-contamination under burst load (S5 concurrency_burst window)

note: 16/16 browser regression tests passed. BR-15 and BR-16 are new cases added for P1.20 to cover restart isolation (S2) and concurrency session isolation (S5). All 14 P1.19 cases carried forward and confirmed.
